title: Hogtopia
tagline: A tiny strategy game about growth, by PostHog

text.win: The map is yours. Every city ships, every metric points up.
text.lose: The rival held on this time. Regroup, rethink, and try another strategy.
text.credits: Made with PostHog. Music and art generated locally.

rival.name: Legacy Monolith
taunts: Nobody has touched me since 2009. Nobody will.
Another city under my maintenance window!
rival.defeat: The monolith is decomposed into tidy little services.
rival.sprite_prompt: a looming grey stone slab monster with glowing red eyes and dusty server lights

tips: Grab villages early: every city means more stars each turn.
Harvest resources in your land to level up cities.
Data Warehouse pays for itself within a few turns.
Forests and your own cities make units harder to hit.
game.hq_prompt: a friendly modern office building with a big hedgehog flag on the roof
